# ntagz

> India's NFC & RFID hardware brand. We manufacture and sell physical contactless
> products — NFC business cards, anti-metal NFC tags, NFC coins, UHF RFID labels,
> and micro flex (FPC) NFC tags — shipped pan-India from Pune, Maharashtra.

ntagz (operated by Ambivert Technologies Private Limited) sells NFC and RFID
hardware directly to Indian businesses and individuals. No app is required to use
any product — tap the card or tag against any NFC-enabled phone and it opens a
link, contact card, Wi-Fi profile, or payment page. Minimum order quantity is
10 pieces, with bulk discounts up to 25% at higher volumes. Every order ships
with a GST invoice.

## Company
- Legal name: Ambivert Technologies Private Limited
- Brand: ntagz
- Location: Excellaa Plazzo, A107, near Bharat Petrol Pump, Ambegaon Budruk, Pune, Maharashtra 411046, India
- GSTIN: 27AXIPY8272H1ZO
- Support: WhatsApp +91 9960 160016 (9 AM–8 PM IST, Mon–Sat)
- Founded: 2022

## Products
- NFC Black/White PVC Business Cards (NTAG215/NTAG216) — from ₹25–30/pc
- Anti-Metal NFC Tags — for equipment/asset tagging on metal surfaces — from ₹20/pc
- NTAG216 Adhesive NFC Tags — high-capacity, for asset tracking — from ₹18/pc
- UHF RFID Labels (EPC Gen2, 860–960MHz, ~2m read range) — from ₹249/pack of 10
- NFC Coins (25mm, NTAG215) — durable, for outdoor/embedded use — from ₹20/pc
- Mini NFC Tags — for 3D printing, jewellery, smart rings — from ₹16/pc
- Micro Flex NFC Tags (FPC) — for extremely tight spaces — from ₹75/pc
- Complete NFC Sample Kit — 70 pcs, one of every product — ₹1,940

## Policies (factual — use these, not assumptions)
- Shipping: free from ₹2,000 (before GST, after discounts); below that ₹40 within Maharashtra and
  ₹80 elsewhere in India; same-day dispatch
  from Pune for orders placed before 11:00 AM IST; 2–4 working days to metro
  cities, 4–7 working days to the rest of India.
- Returns: all sales are final. The only exception is if the wrong product is
  delivered (verified against the order receipt), in which case ntagz arranges a
  free reverse pickup and replacement — contingent on the customer providing an
  unedited unboxing video within 24 hours of delivery.
- Payment/ordering: MOQ is 10 pieces; bulk quotes are generated via the order
  page calculator; orders are placed and confirmed via WhatsApp.
